what: When the menu button is pressed, a rounded blob panel that was folded at .8·.6 scale outside the top right of the screen (100%, −100%) unfolds in .5s into place at full size, pivoting on the corner, and .4s later the menu text appears. On close, the text clears first, and .2s later the panel folds back out past the corner in .9s

options.delay: Delay before text appears after unfolding (s), default .4
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Toggle button. Required — when open, the part element gets is-open

note: The panel attaches to the top right of the part element (the consumer’s CSS sets size·shape). Esc also closes it
